title: United States v. Salim Ahmed Said, preliminary order of forfeiture, ECF 805

supports: ECF 805, filed February 27, 2026, is a signed preliminary forfeiture order as to Salim Ahmed Said (defendant 3) in 0:22-cr-00223-NEB-DTS.
Page 4 paragraph 4 enters a $7,837,656.60 forfeiture money judgment; paragraph 5 requires credit for net forfeited asset value against that same judgment.

Pages 2–4 identify seized bank funds, several properties, vehicles and other assets. Several assets are listed under two statutory forfeiture theories; those descriptions do not create separate additive recoveries.
Page 5 paragraph 9 provides that the preliminary order becomes final as to the defendant at sentencing and must be included in the criminal judgment.
DOJ's October 30 release separately reports Said was sentenced October 28, 2026; the signed October sentencing judgment has not been acquired here.
does_not_support: Any value actually realized from assets, amounts distributed to victims, or cash recovered by government.
A new $7,837,656.60 amount in addition to the value of listed seized assets.
A signed October 28 judgment or any specific Said restitution figure.
That this preliminary order was unchanged in the October sentencing judgment, or finality as to third parties.
